models.name: discussion_board_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device and anonymous attributes.

This table stores records representing unauthenticated guest users temporarily connected to the discussion board. Each guest is uniquely identified by device fingerprint and anonymous session attributes to enable limited tracking and user experience customization without full registration.

No authentication credentials are stored as guests do not log in. Temporal fields track creation, update, and soft deletion statuses.

Separate session table discussion_board_guest_sessions tracks login sessions separately.

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: A unique string fingerprint identifying the guest's device for session continuity and tracking.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User-Agent string of the guest's browser or client for analytics and display customization.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest for security and limited geo-location features.

plainFields.name: anonymous_id
plainFields.description: Randomly generated anonymous identifier to uniquely represent the guest user without PII.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens supporting guest access with device recognition, tracking IP address, visited URL, referrer, and session expiration. Linked to guest entity for authentication context.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest account's discussion_board_guests.id.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the guest connected.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page visited by the guest.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL leading to the guest's session start.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session record was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid.

models.name: discussion_board_registered_users
models.description: Registered user accounts with email/password credentials and profile data. This table stores authentication credentials (email, password hash), user profile details (display name, bio), and status flags. It is the main actor table for registered users in the discussion board system managing economic and political discussions. Includes unique email constraint for login, and soft delete for account removal.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's unique email address used for login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the user's password for authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name shown in profiles and articles.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Free-text user biography shown in profile.

plainFields.name: is_banned
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the user is banned from login and posting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft deleted, null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_registered_user_sessions

plainFields.name: ip

plainFields.name: href

plainFields.name: referrer

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp.

foreignFields.description: Belonged registered user {@link discussion_board_registered_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: discussion_board_registered_user_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens to manage user email confirmation process for registered users. Each record associates a unique token with a registered user along with expiration and timestamps.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated privileges and role management. This table stores login credentials for administrators, including email and password hash, and links to their grade/role in the system. Administrators have full user capabilities plus administrative powers such as managing sections, deleting articles and comments, and banning users.

foreignFields.description: Administrator grade reference. {@link discussion_board_administrator_grades.id}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for administrator login credentials.

plainFields.name: password_hash

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_administrator_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens managing administrator authentication sessions. Stores session metadata including IP address, URL initiated from, referrer, creation and expiration timestamps. Linked to owning administrator via foreign key administrator_id referencing discussion_board_administrators. Enables authentication lifecycle management and session auditing.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Owning administrator's {@link discussion_board_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The full URL of the page used to initiate the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires, marking session invalidity.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion of the session; null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_administrator_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for administrators to enable secure password recovery. This table links each token to an administrator account and records the token value, expiration timestamp, and auditing timestamps (creation, update, deletion).

plainFields.name: expired_at

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_super_administrators
models.description: Super administrator accounts represent the highest-level privileged users in the system with full control over administrative roles and permissions. This table stores essential authentication data such as unique email and hashed passwords, profile display name and bio for identification, and supports soft deletion for account lifecycle management. It serves as the root actor entity for super administrators and relates to session and password reset tables.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for login and identification of the super administrator.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password value for authenticating the super administrator.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name for the super administrator profile, shown in the UI.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Optional biography or description text for the super administrator profile.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp recording when the super administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the super administrator account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: discussion_board_super_administrator_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens that manage authentication sessions for super administrators. Each session records connection context including IP address, referrer URL, and user agent (href). Sessions are time-limited with creation and expiration timestamps to ensure security and auditability.

foreignFields.name: super_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The associated super administrator's {@link discussion_board_super_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session originated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: User agent or originating URL captured for session tracking.

plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the client during session initiation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session will expire, enforcing session lifecycle.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of the session record, if applicable.

models.name: discussion_board_super_administrator_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for super administrators to secure sensitive accounts. Each token uniquely identifies a password reset request and includes expiration for security. References the owning super administrator account.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_super_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Owning super administrator's {@link discussion_board_super_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string used for password reset authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration time for the password reset token to maintain security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: discussion_board_audit_logs

models.name: discussion_board_scheduled_tasks

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: discussion_board_mv_tag_usage_stats
models.description: Materialized view aggregating tag usage statistics to optimize search and filtering performance in discussion board articles. Provides precomputed counts of articles and comments per tag with refresh timestamps.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: References the tag aggregated in this usage statistic. {@link discussion_board_tags.id}

plainFields.name: article_count
plainFields.description: Number of articles tagged with this tag.

plainFields.name: comment_count
plainFields.description: Number of comments associated with articles tagged by this tag.

plainFields.name: refreshed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this materialized view entry was last refreshed.

models.name: discussion_board_article_tags
models.description: Many-to-many relationship between articles and tags enabling flexible categorization and filtering of articles by tags. Connects each tag to one or more articles and each article to multiple tags, facilitating efficient searching and filtering.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Referencing article's unique identifier. The target article associated with this tag. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Referencing tag's unique identifier. The associated tag for the article. {@link discussion_board_tags.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if not deleted.
